model: per group: log(real) = a + b log(h25) (weighted Huber, delta 0.25), plus a local correction of nearby anchors' log residuals; calibrated = clip(exp(line + correction), ratio clamp x h25, height clamp)

filters.junk: real < 2 m, real > 500 m, or OSM levels and height disagree by more than max(2, half) floors
filters.mass_tag: a 2000 m block with >= 50 OSM truth rows where one value covers >= 85% (bulk-tagged default levels)
filters.osm_part: not used in fits (only recorded where taller than the 2.5D value: biased)

local.kernel: w = (1 - d/R)^2 * exp(-(log h25_anchor - log h25)^2 / (2 sigma^2)); corr = sum(w res) / (sum(w) + k)

est.idw: power 1, distance floor 5 m, raw 2.5D heights of g25 rows of the same file

tall.model: targets: g25 rows of calibrated groups with raw h25 >= T. alpha = weighted median of real / h25 over anchors whose h25 is within the window of the target's raw h25 (saturated targets: every saturated anchor), from the smallest radius holding >= N such anchors; past the last radius, fallback "main" keeps the main-stage value, fallback "band" tries the province, then the national band alpha. alpha clamped; height = exp(log main + lam (log clip(alpha x raw h25, height clamp) - log main)). Rows with raw h25 < T keep the main-stage value. Always applied from raw h25 (see raw_source).
tall.raw_source: raw 2.5D values (height_src g25) exist only in the by_area files of commit 703e019; export them with "git archive 703e019 buildings/by_area | tar -x" into data/buildings/_calib and apply with --src-dir data/buildings/_calib/raw_by_area --out-dir buildings/by_area (main + tall stage, from raw)

settings.anchor_rule: clean truth rows (main-stage exclusions) with h25 >= 30 m or real >= 60 m

weights_rule.similarity: max(0.1, 1 - |h25_anchor - h25| / (0.25 h25)); 1 between saturated values

selection.criterion: inner 5-fold block CV MAE (m) over all training calibration rows
